title: GameValue
description: A player-count-scaled integer value (Arkham.GameValue), used for shroud, clue thresholds, and doom thresholds. A closed, non-additive union: every constructor is enumerated here.

contents.description: Absent for the nullary ValueX/ValueStar/ValueUnknown tags. A single integer for Static/PerPlayer, a 2-tuple for StaticWithPerPlayer, and a 4-tuple (one value per player count 1-4) for ByPlayerCount.
